title: Every Feature, Every Commit, Instantly Linked | vitalii.no
description:
Managing 5+ portfolio projects across multiple GitHub repos, verifying any of my 100+ features was a constant headache. I'd routinely burn 15 to 30 minutes per feature manually digging through commit histories just to answer 'where did this come from?' or 'what changed here?'.

I rebuilt the feature-scanner GitHub Action to iterate a repo list, hit the GitHub API for commit messages and file changes, and extract feature details plus the precise commit URL through a custom parseFeatureData function. The structured output is persisted to public/features.json, and the React frontend renders every feature with its direct commit link. A FeatureAdminPanel handles edge cases with manual overrides, keeping the data 100% accurate.

Tracing any feature now takes seconds instead of 15 to 30 minutes — a 95% cut in investigation time across 100+ features and 5+ repositories, with full auditability built in.
